title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Sales Development agent for autonomous lead outreach
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap targets, preview activation, permissions and Copilot Credit billing are supported by the sources checked. Minor corrections concern an omitted navigation heading and send-time guidance without a corresponding controls-table row.
